opportunities.title: Nuffield Farming Next-Gen Scholarship

amount.raw: The successful applicants will be awarded a Next-Gen Scholarship worth £6,000. The scholarship includes a financial incentive of £1000 to part cover replacement labour cost.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Young people aged 18-24, resident in the UK, with a demonstrable interest in the relevant sector (e.g. dairy, regenerative agriculture, pig).
opportunities.summary: Aims to develop young talent in the agriculture industry by linking successful applicants directly to farmers via the Nuffield Scholar network. It funds a 30-day study programme (June/July) staying on farms with Nuffield Scholars, fully funded including all travel and subsistence, attendance at the Nuffield Conference, and Nuffield Farming Associate membership. The 2027 programme plans to award three dairy and three pig scholarships.
